speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing agitation and have noticed a yellowish coloring in your skin and eyes; to understand the cause of these symptoms, how long have you been feeling unwell and have you had any recent illnesses or alcohol consumption?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatitis B infection with acute liver failure. The combination of jaundice, agitation, recent high-risk sexual behavior, and a healthy prior history strongly points to viral hepatitis causing acute liver injury.
